messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need a per-route KPI tile in Console that shows p50/p95/p99 token-level latency, throughput (req/s), and error rate. Also want a token-level waterfall so we can see KV-caching and kernel selection impact.

sam: SG. Do we have instrumentation for per-token kernel selection latency? last prof showed kernel-switch cost spikes at step 3.

eli: We have per-token timing at the runtime level but it's currently sampled at 1/10. I can add a debug histogram exported as prom_msec_token_latency_bucket{route, kernel, step}.

dena: Important: product wants baseline+compare mode so PMs can toggle model variant and see p95 delta. Also set alert if p99 increases by >15% from baseline.

sam: For alerting, suggest computing delta via recording rules: kpi_p99_route = histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(prom_msec_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))

maya: Nice. Also include a small table with top 10 routes by cost (tokens * compute_ms) and a quick action link to rollback.

eli: Will add panels: (1) stacked waterfall (prefix/KV/kernel/op), (2) p50/p95/p99 timeseries by route, (3) throughput heatmap, (4) error-rate trend + 5min-rate, (5) top-10 cost table.

metrics-bot: deploy:dashboard/generate triggered by eli — build in staging, will post link when ready :rocket:

dena: UX ask — show per-route sampling rate and a note when low-sample noise might affect p99 numbers.

maya: Agreed. Let's keep default retention 14d and 1min rollup. Team — eli please post PR with example panels + prom rules. Thanks :thumbsup:
